description: Short interest in US stocks from FINRA, twice a month: shares short, the change, average daily volume and days to cover over several reports, and the share of shares outstanding from the company's latest SEC cover page; or, with no stock, the market ranked by days to cover, change or size.

limit.description: Across the market, most stocks to list; default 25.

min_volume.description: Across the market, only stocks averaging at least this many shares a day; default 1,000,000, so thin stocks do not crowd the list.

periods.description: Settlement dates to show for a stock, newest last; default 6 (three months).

rank_by.description: Across the market: days to cover (default), the change since the last report, or shares short.

symbol.description: A US stock ticker. Without it, the whole market at the latest settlement date, ranked.

name: short_interest

outputSchema.description: rows are settlement dates (one stock) or stocks (the market), in the order of columns; change_pct and pct_of_shares_outstanding are fractions.

title: Short interest (FINRA)
